name: Breadbasket Guild
summary: The Breadbasket Guild is a coalition of Westfall farmers, former Defias laborers, and homeless war refugees striving to restore the breadbasket of the kingdom. Operating out of the Saldean farmstead, they seek to repair neglected homesteads and petition Stormwind for real civic aid. Their grassroots movement represents a desperate attempt by common folk to rebuild their lives despite political indifference.

sections.title: Reclaiming the Soil
sections.body: Decades of war, gnoll raids, and brigandage left Westfall's golden fields charred and untended. As displaced refugees poured south from torn homelands, local farmers like the Saldeans banded together with reformed bandits and laborers to form the Breadbasket Guild. Based out of Saldean's Farm, the guild aims to clear overgrown plots, build sturdy shelters for displaced folk, and coordinate planting efforts to sustain the realm once again.

sections.title: A Plea to the Crown
sections.body: While Westfall fed Stormwind for generations, its pleas for royal protection have long gone unanswered. To counter this neglect, the guild formalized its charter to petition the House of Nobles directly. Sympathizers among the nobility have occasionally lent an ear, recognizing that Stormwind cannot eat stone. However, many aristocrats remain deeply suspicious of any organized labor emerging from the very province that birthed the Defias uprising.

faq.answer: It is a cooperative association of Westfall farmers, displaced refugees, and former Defias laborers. Their goal is to revitalize Westfall by repairing homesteads, tilling abandoned fields, and securing official recognition and assistance from Stormwind City.

faq.q: Where does the Breadbasket Guild meet?
faq.answer: The guild gathers at Saldean's Farm, located in central Westfall along the road. Farmer Saldean and Salma Saldean host the collective as one of the few resilient farming families remaining in the region.

faq.q: Why did the farmers form a guild?
faq.answer: Individual homesteads cannot survive the bandits, gnolls, and mechanized harvest reapers alone. By banding together into an official body, the settlers can pool food, tools, and labor while giving Westfall an organized political voice in Stormwind.

faq.q: Are former Defias members really involved?
faq.answer: Yes. Many laborers who originally joined the Defias did so out of desperation and starvation rather than a thirst for crime. The guild provides these workers a peaceful path back into society to rebuild their communities with honest farming.

faq.q: How does Stormwind view the guild?
faq.answer: Stormwind's nobility is wary of organized commoners in Westfall due to the ongoing Defias rebellion. While some landholding nobles recognize the kingdom needs grain to survive, others view any organized assembly of rural laborers as potential subversion.

faq.q: Who are the prominent members of the guild?
faq.answer: Respected local settlers form its backbone, notably Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma, alongside workers such as Ethel Siltsift, Gerget Hardhands, and Heather May.

angles.text: For humans of Stormwind, Westfall's soil represents the heart of the realm's survival; supporting the guild helps heal the painful divide between the capital and the rural poor.
The Alliance relies heavily on Westfall for grain and livestock; securing the farms ensures vital supply chains remain stable amid constant border skirmishes.
Culinarians visiting the Saldean farmstead will find kindred spirits dedicated to harvesting the staple grains, onions, and meats that feed southern Azeroth.
